seo.title: Refusal and undo-label codes — OpenMixer
seo.description: Every refusal, warning and undo-entry code the server can send, with the parameters each one carries — generated from the code’s own message registry.

docsRefusalCodes.title: Refusal and undo-label codes
docsRefusalCodes.lede: Nothing below the surface ever emits display prose. A refusal, a warning or an undo-entry label travels as a stable code plus a small record of named parameters, and the client renders it in the operator's own locale. {count} codes, generated from the registry that also gates the server's own build.
